assignments.name: raw_text
assignments.value: We need 2000 paper cans, 80 mm diameter and 150 mm height for coffee packaging. Delivery to Delhi. Printed artwork required.

nodes.name: Enquiry Input
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: change enquiry_id, source and raw_text here to test other enquiries. No configuration needed otherwise.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: "You extract structured sales-lead data from customer enquiries for Moti Packaging Industries (paper cans / packaging). Return ONLY a valid JSON object with exactly these keys: customer_name, company_name, contact, product_category, diameter_mm, height_mm, quantity, application, printing_requirement, delivery_location, required_date, missing_fields, conflicting_fields, technical_concerns, human_review_required. RULES: Never guess or infer missing details; use null for any unknown value. diameter_mm, height_mm and quantity must be numbers or null. required_date must be YYYY-MM-DD or null. printing_requirement is a short string describing printing/artwork needs, or null. missing_fields, conflicting_fields and technical_concerns are arrays of strings (empty array if none). human_review_required is true or false. Enquiry source: " + $json.source + ". Enquiry text: " + $json.raw_text }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0, responseMimeType: "application/json" } }) }}

nodes.name: Gemini Extract
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: select/create the "Google Gemini(PaLM) API" credential and paste your Gemini API key there (never in the node). Retries 3 times on temporary failures; if still failing, the enquiry continues to the Validate node and is saved as "Processing failed".

nodes.name: Validate AI Response
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: edit the RULES block at the top of the code once your manufacturing rules are approved (approved: true + limits). Until then no enquiry can be "Ready for quotation". Handles API errors, empty and invalid JSON by saving a "Processing failed" record.

nodes.name: Lookup Existing Enquiries
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: connect Google Sheets credentials and pick your Enquiries spreadsheet + sheet (same one as the Save node). Reads all existing rows so the next node can compare contact + enquiry details. If this node is not configured or fails, the enquiry still continues and is flagged "duplicate check not run".

nodes.name: Check Duplicates and Draft Reply
nodes.notes: No configuration needed. Compares the new enquiry with the sheet rows (contact + dimensions/quantity/product), flags a possible duplicate (keeps both records, deletes nothing) and writes a follow-up DRAFT that only uses verified details. Nothing is sent.

nodes.name: Save Enquiry to Sheet
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: connect Google Sheets credentials and pick the SAME spreadsheet + sheet as the lookup node. Row 1 of the sheet must contain these headers: enquiry_id, received_at, source, raw_text, customer_name, company_name, contact, product_category, diameter_mm, height_mm, quantity, application, printing_requirement, delivery_location, required_date, missing_fields, lead_status, duplicate_of, human_review, followup_draft, error. Failed records are saved with lead_status "Processing failed" - filter on it to reprocess.
